summary: Added a dependency-free Application-layer URL normalizer for scheme/host casing, default ports, and lowercase utm_ query parameters.
rationale: The provided artifacts did not include the existing source files, so I could not safely modify LinkService to invoke the normalizer without risking existing behavior or compilation. This adds the normalizer only; creation-flow integration remains necessary.
content: Added `UrlNormalizer.Normalize(string)` in the Application layer. It retains unrelated query parameters and URL components while removing `utm_` parameters.
